text.en:
Section 6, sub-section a, Presidential Decree No. 1264, is hereby amended to read as follows:
"a. The term of office of all members of the Board shall be four years, including those appointed by the
President of the Philippines, renewable at the pleasure of the appointing power or elective bodies."
DONE in the City of Manila, this 1st day of October, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-nine.
